create_ddpg_agent: create a DDPG agent with policy and critic networks for continuous control reinforcement learning
build_ddpg_replay_server: build a Reverb replay server with uniform sampling and FIFO removal for the DDPG agent
configure_ddpg_behavior_network: configure a behavior network with clipped Gaussian exploration noise and action clipping for DDPG
initialize_ddpg_learner: initialize a DDPG learner with Adam optimizers for policy and critic network training
setup_ddpg_nstep_adder: setup an N-step transition adder with configurable discount and step length for the DDPG replay buffer
